stem.text: Chlorine dioxide, $\text{ClO}_2$, reacts with sodium hydroxide in the reaction shown.
Which statement correctly describes this redox reaction?

A.text: Chlorine atoms are oxidised and oxygen atoms are reduced.

B.text: Chlorine atoms are reduced and oxygen atoms are oxidised.

C.text: Some chlorine atoms are oxidised and some chlorine atoms are reduced.

D.text: Some oxygen atoms are oxidised and some oxygen atoms are reduced.
